geometry_scope: Independent reconstruction of one periodic Model 6 hot-fluid/cold-fluid/solid-plate cell; not author CAD.
identity_method: SHA-256 of STEP bytes after normalizing only the export timestamp in the STEP FILE_NAME header; geometry parameters and region volumes compared across levels.
limitation: Identity proves that the same reconstructed geometry was meshed; it does not establish fidelity to the paper CAD, near-wall adequacy, or scientific validity.
